description: Golden vectors for the offline workout command protocol, slice V0 (hashVersion 2, CompleteSet APPEND). Source: docs/v1/design/OFFLINE_COMMAND_PROTOCOL.md section 2.1 and 2.2; canonicalizer under test: functions/src/workout_commands/canonical.ts. Canonical form: UTF-8 JSON without whitespace, object keys sorted recursively by UTF-16 code unit order, arrays in their given order, integers only (no fraction, no exponent, safe-integer range), explicit null for nullable fields, strings escaped as JSON.stringify does (raw UTF-8 for non-ASCII, \u00xx lowercase for control characters other than \b \f \n \r \t). payloadHash = lowercase hex SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes of payloadText. uidTag = base64url (no padding) of the first 6 bytes of SHA-256('u1|' + uid), 8 characters; operationId = uidTag + 22 base64url characters. Field layout of a vector: name (unique id), description, authUid (the authenticated user submitting), requestSessionId (sessionId of the callable request), uidTag (of authUid), payloadObject (the logical payload as JSON, or null when the vector is about raw text), canonicalText (what a correct canonicalizer MUST produce from payloadObject, null when payloadObject is null), payloadText (the exact text that is hashed and sent as payloadBytes; equals canonicalText unless the vector is a deliberately non-canonical text), payloadHash (SHA-256 hex of payloadText), sentPayloadHash (only when the envelope hash is deliberately wrong), expectedPrepare (server outcome of envelope validation before any read: OK, INVALID_PAYLOAD, UID_MISMATCH, ID_UID_MISMATCH, ID_SESSION_MISMATCH), pairedWith/pairExpectation (pair semantics). Dart consumers: for every vector with payloadObject != null, canonicalize payloadObject and compare to canonicalText and SHA-256 of it to payloadHash; for vectors with payloadObject == null only the hash of payloadText is checked and a strict parser must reject the text as non-canonical. Hashes were produced by running canonical.ts and re-verified by functions/scripts/verify_workout_command_vectors.mjs (Node crypto over the literal strings) and by Python hashlib.

vectors.name: minimal_complete_set_append_with_session_init
vectors.description: First CompleteSet APPEND of a new session: sessionInit present, empty dependsOn, acceptedEpoch 0.

vectors.name: nulls_and_one_dependency_without_session_init
vectors.description: Nullable fixed fields are explicit null (actualReps, targetReps, loadGrams, dayId absent because sessionInit is null); one dependsOn entry; setIndex 2.

vectors.name: key_ordering_stress_reverse_input_order
vectors.description: payloadObject is listed with keys in reverse lexicographic order at every depth; canonicalText must still be fully key-sorted with arrays kept in their given (sorted, ascending) order. Three dependsOn ids.

vectors.name: non_canonical_key_order_text_rejected
vectors.description: Same content as key_ordering_stress but the bytes are sent with acceptedEpoch moved last. Valid JSON, valid schema, NOT canonical: the server must answer INVALID_PAYLOAD (it hashes only canonical bytes).

vectors.name: whitespace_in_text_rejected
vectors.description: Canonical content with one space after a colon: not canonical, INVALID_PAYLOAD.

vectors.name: decimal_point_integer_text_rejected
vectors.description: seq written as 1.0 in the text: JSON parses to 1 but the text is not the canonical form (integers only, no fraction), INVALID_PAYLOAD.

vectors.name: exponent_integer_text_rejected
vectors.description: loadGrams written as 6e4: not canonical, INVALID_PAYLOAD.

vectors.name: integer_boundaries_max_accepted
vectors.description: Every integer at its inclusive maximum: sessionGeneration 1000000, acceptedEpoch 1000000, seq 2147483647, setIndex 1000 (set_1000), actualReps 1000, targetReps 1000, loadGrams 1000000, performedAtClientMs and startedAtClientMs 9007199254740991 (2^53-1).

vectors.name: integer_boundaries_min_accepted
vectors.description: Every integer at its inclusive minimum: sessionGeneration 1, acceptedEpoch 0, seq 1, setIndex 1, actualReps 0, targetReps 0, loadGrams 0, performedAtClientMs 0, startedAtClientMs 0.

vectors.name: seq_above_int32_rejected
vectors.description: Out of range: seq 2147483648. The canonicalizer can still produce text; the server answers INVALID_PAYLOAD.

vectors.name: seq_zero_rejected
vectors.description: Out of range: seq 0. The canonicalizer can still produce text; the server answers INVALID_PAYLOAD.

vectors.name: session_generation_zero_rejected
vectors.description: Out of range: sessionGeneration 0. The canonicalizer can still produce text; the server answers INVALID_PAYLOAD.

vectors.name: accepted_epoch_negative_rejected
vectors.description: Out of range: acceptedEpoch -1. The canonicalizer can still produce text; the server answers INVALID_PAYLOAD.

vectors.name: load_grams_above_max_rejected
vectors.description: Out of range: loadGrams 1000001. The canonicalizer can still produce text; the server answers INVALID_PAYLOAD.

vectors.name: actual_reps_above_max_rejected
vectors.description: Out of range: actualReps 1001. The canonicalizer can still produce text; the server answers INVALID_PAYLOAD.

vectors.name: performed_at_negative_rejected
vectors.description: Out of range: performedAtClientMs -1. The canonicalizer can still produce text; the server answers INVALID_PAYLOAD.

vectors.name: set_index_zero_rejected
vectors.description: logicalSetId index 0 (and setId set_0000): outside 1..1000, INVALID_PAYLOAD.

vectors.name: set_index_leading_zero_rejected
vectors.description: logicalSetId index written 01: not canonical decimal, INVALID_PAYLOAD.

vectors.name: unicode_title_key_rejected
vectors.description: titleKey is a closed ASCII set (default, day:{id}, plan:{id}); a non-ASCII id inside titleKey is INVALID_PAYLOAD.

vectors.name: unicode_exercise_id_rejected
vectors.description: ids match ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}$; a non-ASCII exerciseId is INVALID_PAYLOAD.

vectors.name: unicode_uid_accepted_utf8_not_escaped
vectors.description: uid is only length-checked (1..128 UTF-16 units), so a non-ASCII uid is accepted. Canonical text carries it as raw UTF-8 (NOT \u-escaped, astral character as one 4-byte sequence); the hash is over those UTF-8 bytes. uidTag is derived from the UTF-8 bytes of the uid.

vectors.name: uid_json_escapes_accepted
vectors.description: uid with a double quote, backslash, newline, tab, U+0001, U+007F and U+2028. Canonical escapes: \" \\ \n \t \u0001 (lowercase hex, 4 digits); U+007F and U+2028 stay raw. Pins the string escaping rules for the Dart canonicalizer.

vectors.name: same_operation_id_original
vectors.description: Original command of the altered-payload pair.
vectors.pairExpectation: Each is valid alone. Submitting this and then the altered one gives COMMITTED then ID_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH; the hashes differ.

vectors.name: same_operation_id_altered_reps
vectors.description: Same operationId, actualReps changed 8 -> 9.
vectors.pairExpectation: payloadHash differs from the original under the identical operationId.

vectors.name: uid_mismatch_payload_uid_differs_from_auth
vectors.description: Payload minted for user B but submitted by authenticated user A: UID_MISMATCH before any read.

vectors.name: id_uid_mismatch_operation_id_tag_of_other_user
vectors.description: payload.uid equals the authenticated user B but operationId carries the uidTag of user A: ID_UID_MISMATCH.

vectors.name: different_uid_same_content_different_hash
vectors.description: Same logical content as minimal_complete_set_append_with_session_init but minted for user B: operationId tag, uid and therefore the hash all differ (the hash binds identity).

vectors.name: session_id_mismatch_with_request
vectors.description: payload.sessionId differs from the sessionId of the request: ID_SESSION_MISMATCH.

vectors.name: client_hash_does_not_match_bytes
vectors.description: The envelope payloadHash has its first hex digit changed: the server recomputes and answers INVALID_PAYLOAD.

vectors.name: update_mode_not_accepted_in_v0
vectors.description: body.mode CORRECT is outside slice V0 (APPEND only): INVALID_PAYLOAD.

vectors.name: depends_on_unsorted_rejected
vectors.description: dependsOn must be ascending without duplicates; reversed order is INVALID_PAYLOAD.

vectors.name: reserved_session_id_rejected
vectors.description: sessionId __proto__ matches the reserved pattern ^__.*__$: INVALID_PAYLOAD (also a batch-level invalid-argument as a request sessionId).

vectors.name: reserved_exercise_id_rejected
vectors.description: exerciseId __a__ matches the reserved pattern: INVALID_PAYLOAD.

vectors.name: lone_surrogate_raw_text_rejected
vectors.description: uid contains an unpaired high surrogate written RAW in the text (not as a backslash-u-d800 escape). The canonical form escapes it, so the raw text is not canonical: INVALID_PAYLOAD. payloadHash is SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes where the lone surrogate encodes as U+FFFD (EF BF BD), as Node Buffer and Dart utf8.encode do; Python must use errors='replace'.

vectors.name: lone_surrogate_escaped_uid_rejected
vectors.description: uid contains an unpaired surrogate written as the 6-character escape backslash-u-d800. A canonicalizer cannot represent it (canonicalJson throws), so the server answers INVALID_PAYLOAD. payloadObject is null because no canonical text exists; payloadHash is only the SHA-256 of this literal ASCII text for verifier consistency.

vectors.name: depends_on_ascii_order_dash_upper_underscore_accepted
vectors.description: Three dependsOn ids that differ only at one position, with characters '-' (45), 'A' (65), '_' (95): ascending UTF-16/ASCII order is - < A < _ (NOT case-insensitive or locale order). Accepted.

vectors.name: depends_on_wrong_order_underscore_before_upper_rejected
vectors.description: Same ids ordered - < _ < A (what a case-insensitive or locale sort could produce): INVALID_PAYLOAD.

vectors.name: depends_on_mixed_case_lower_after_underscore_accepted
vectors.description: Differing character 'A' (65), '_' (95), 'a' (97): ascending order A < _ < a is accepted.

vectors.name: negative_zero_text_rejected
vectors.description: acceptedEpoch written -0: JSON parses to negative zero, the canonical form is 0, so the text is not canonical: INVALID_PAYLOAD. A canonicalizer must never emit -0.
